_comment: Enforced by .cursor/hooks/lane-guard.sh. docs/process/LANES.md is the human-readable companion; keep them in step. A lane may write only paths matching its own globs. Anything unclaimed is open. Editing the main checkout's source is denied outright - the owner plays there.
_contested: Owned by no single lane and shared by several. Denied to everyone BY DEFAULT: a silent parallel edit here is how work gets clobbered. A file that must change now has a legal path: the orchestrator adds a `grants` entry giving it to ONE lane, temporarily and with a reason. Contested is the resting state; a grant is the exception, not a re-owning.
_grants: A temporary, exclusive, auditable claim on a contested or otherwise-owned path, so a file that must change has a legal path to changing without being permanently re-owned. While a grant stands, the named lane may write the listed paths (this overrides contested AND another lane's ownership); every OTHER lane is denied them, exactly as if that lane owned them. Honoured by lane-guard.sh and reported by scripts/check-lane-integrity.mjs. Each entry states the lane, the exact paths, a reason, and the date granted, so the grant is visible and can be retired when the work lands. Keep the list short: a grant that outlives its work should be deleted, and if a lane keeps needing a path, give it the path outright instead.

grants.reason: FULL M1 WORLD BUILD (owner GO, 31 Jul): build/re-author the Covenant-mission world per docs/design/M1-Covenant-World-Build.md, with continuous physics/traversability verification and a final full-playthrough QA. m1-evasion-loop owns the M1 world surface for this build: packages/mission-m1/** (level layout, route, assets, compile/runtime/types, encounters, ladders), M1Scenery.tsx + m1Mission.ts (scene placement + mission wiring), the engine-world parkour files (HANG_DROP IK + mantle tuning + clips), the world-audit building GLBs + their pipeline globs (printshop Blender hollow-out + any building edits), the *ladder* pipeline, and the clip-fidelity/affordance QA scripts. REUSE-FIRST: most props + the wharf kit + ships + liberty-elm + interior shells are reused in place (placed via the level files, GLBs not edited) or are UNOWNED, so no grant is needed; assets/pipeline gen/bake/optimize/sync + assets/source + apps/web/public/world/{structures,characters/playerboy-rigged.glb} are UNOWNED and fall through to allow. NOT granted (worker flags if needed): engine-world/{contact,collision}.ts core (kept with mission-world so the guard's grant selftest stays green) and liberty-elm-hero.glb (mission-flow; the elm is repositioned via the level files, not edited). All other lanes are parked under the M1-only freeze, so this consolidation evicts no live worker. Granted 2026-07-31; supersedes the 2026-07-30 traversability-closure grant. Retire when the world build merges to main; then re-point lane-guard.sh's grant selftest cases.

The owner-approved atomic migration of M1's content set to the 1774 Coercive Acts slate. The module deck is on the critical path: verify:content couples its cue/check/concept ids to concepts.json, duel-items.json, codex-cards.json and the capstone, and apps/api's module-deck parity gate compares the server's transcription against it, so the deck cannot be migrated anywhere else and no partial pass is green-able. Replaces the module-lesson grant, whose stated retirement condition ('Retire when the lesson rework merges') was met when workflow/m1-lesson merged at 73a4b58 — that lane's Archive rework and the m1-sources manifest are both contained in main. Granted by the orchestrator on 2026-07-30 after the m1-1774 worker correctly REFUSED to grant itself the file and reported instead. This migration is cross-cutting by nature (~50 files across curriculum, content, apps/api, apps/web and packages/{duel,pvp,grading,mission-m1}); check-lane-integrity will report those as cross-lane edits, which are expected and authorised here rather than accidental. EXTENDED 2026-07-30 with the capstone-enable paths: the capstone can only be wired where the server serves it (api-hunt's apps/api/src/progression/content.ts plus its capstone/e2e/parity tests and the package.json test script), the subtitle comma bug can only be fixed where it lives (module-lesson's moduleShots.ts), and assessments.ts carries a now-false 'capstone is unwired' comment (boss-fight's) that is actively misleading once the capstone is enabled. KNOWN RECONCILIATION, not a conflict today: workflow/api-hunt adds test/pvp-shipping-card-gate.test.ts to the same apps/api/package.json test-script line, but that branch is PvP work deliberately paused under the M1-only freeze and is not on main — whoever resumes api-hunt must reconcile that one line to list both test files. Retire when the migration merges, and re-point lane-guard.sh's two grant-mechanism selftest cases at whatever grant is live then.

The holographic Archive room replaces the lesson index's flat DOM card list with a real 3D room (procedural shaders and postprocessing, which the asset rule explicitly permits for UI/Archive highlights). Deliberately the FIVE exact files it touches, not the apps/web/src/module/** glob: granting the glob is exclusive and therefore denies it to module-lesson and m1-lesson, which broke lane-guard's own ownership selftest case on ModulePlayer.tsx — the 'a grant overrides ownership in both directions' trap the map documents. A narrow grant records the writer without evicting the co-owners. apps/web/package.json and the CONTESTED pnpm-lock.yaml are included because the room needs @react-three/postprocessing, added via pnpm add in a worktree (the sanctioned path); the lockfile is contested precisely because a silent parallel edit there is unrecoverable, so this makes the change attributable. Granted by the orchestrator on 2026-07-30. Retire when the room merges — and note pnpm-lock.yaml returns to contested, denied to every lane, the moment it does. EXTENDED 2026-07-30: content/m1/module.json + its schema moved here from the retired m1-1774 content grant, for the IRIS naming, the game-open intro cutscene, and the lesson-opening ramp — the same worker owns the presenter/room and the deck it narrates. module.json is now granted ONLY to archive-room. EXTENDED 2026-07-31 with ModuleFilePlayer.tsx to finish the File 1 cutscene RUNTIME on the 'The closure' card: the content drop-in landed (module.json video block, PROJECT_RECONSTRUCTION, public/cutscenes/m1/closure.mp4), but the player hard-codes the <video> muted (VO + dockworker silent, browser TTS talks over it) and ends the card on the narration-beat duration (~21.02s) so the 30.67s clip is cut off mid-line and the document stills are hidden while it plays. archive-room owns the cutscene wiring, so it fixes the runtime: play the reconstruction video WITH its own audio (respecting browser autoplay policy), suppress the TTS narration beat while it plays, drive the card/PLAYING duration from the video length, and restore the Committee circular + mezzotint stills after it. Deliberately the ONE exact file, not the apps/web/src/module/** glob, so parked module-lesson/m1-lesson keep their other files. Retire when the cutscene work merges.

The duel-HUD presentation rework retires the mid-fight interstitial card, moves hits-to-win onto the persistent HUD, deletes the raw damage numerals, and shows the unfired-balls rule once ever. The interstitial IS DuelOverlay.tsx and its styling IS duel.css, so the work cannot be done anywhere else. Both files are contested because boss-fight also had to touch the verdict label; that sequencing is now settled — boss-fight landed FIRST (540c0e3) specifically to protect the 'Not graded' verdict label, verified present on main afterwards — leaving duel-hud the single lane on these two files. Granted by the owner's explicit instruction on 2026-07-29 and recorded here the same day; the work is already committed on workflow/duel-hud at dab549b. A prior agent correctly REFUSED to grant this itself: a self-issued grant is the unrecorded authorisation the map exists to prevent. duel-hud MUST keep rendering verdictBeatTone(verdict).label in VerdictBeat — see the invariant row in docs/process/M1-STATUS.md. Retire when the HUD rework merges.
